title: crepidium pleistanthum
intro: Crepidium pleistanthum, commonly known as the 'Himalayan Crepidium', is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Crepidium pleistanthum have been shown to possess potential therapeutic benefits, although further research is necessary to fully understand its effects on human health.
